pozisyonlar.gerekce: DG has the strongest portfolio-level balance among the full candidates: gross-profit and operating-profit growth exceed revenue growth, indicating operating leverage, and the 7.84% TTM free-cash-flow yield provides valuation support. Its weakening cash conversion prevents a larger commitment, but the thesis is better supported than those of BJ and TGT.
pozisyonlar.tez: Low-single-digit revenue growth can produce faster earnings growth through gross-margin improvement and operating leverage, provided that subsequent filings confirm renewed cash conversion without sacrificing margins.
izleme_kosullari: By 2026-Q2, year-over-year operating cash flow growth must improve beyond -5.0%.
Through 2026-FY, free cash flow margin must remain at or above 3.38%.
Through 2026-FY, gross margin must remain at or above 31.62%.
Through 2026-FY, core operating margin must remain at or above 5.92%.
Monitor whether lease obligations or refinancing needs materially constrain cash available to shareholders.

nakit_gerekcesi: The second slot remains in cash because neither BJ nor TGT currently offers sufficient cash-flow, liquidity, and valuation support. Filling the slot would require accepting unresolved conversion risk merely to complete the basket.

reddedilen_adaylar.gerekce: Revenue grew 9.9%, but operating cash flow declined 32.7%, quarterly free cash flow was negative, liquidity was constrained, and refinancing pressure was high. The 21.70x P/E and 1.76% free-cash-flow yield proxy require evidence of cash-conversion and liquidity improvement before selection.

Revenue and operating cash flow improved, but operating profit contracted 22.9%, current-year-to-date free cash flow was negative, liquidity remained below one, and the 4.48% free-cash-flow yield was explicitly described as unnormalized. The recovery mechanism therefore lacks confirmed profitable and recurring cash conversion.

itiraz_edilen_elemeler.gerekce: The summary reports favorable growth across revenue, operating profit, net profit, operating cash flow, and free cash flow, together with positive liquidity. Those strengths make the valuation-based exclusion worth reconsidering through the unavailable full record.

The summary describes KR as profitable and cash-generative and states that its 7.86% parent-attributed TTM free-cash-flow yield provides some valuation support. This creates enough tension with the valuation-based exclusion to warrant review of the unavailable full record.

portfoy_gerekcesi: The pilot begins with one 50% position in DG and 50% cash. DG offers the clearest combination of operating leverage and valuation support, although its cash-conversion deterioration requires confirmation. BJ carries weaker liquidity, refinancing pressure, negative free cash flow, and limited valuation support; TGT lacks demonstrated earnings and normalized cash-flow recovery. Cash preserves discipline until a second company presents evidence comparable to or stronger than DG.
